name: aibast-library-api
title: AIBAST Agents Library API
description: Everything in the AIBAST Agents Library as static JSON, for AI agents first and people second: each solution, its demo, how to get it, how to learn it and its proof.
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

tiered-huddle-board.intro: This is a preview of the Tiered Huddle Board Agent, answering from sample records.
tiered-huddle-board.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

tiered-huddle-board-board-view.before: A nurse manager is between patients and asks for the huddle board.
tiered-huddle-board-board-view.after: The agent lists what is past target and the one item waiting on her.

tiered-huddle-board-escalation-draft.before: Her unit can't fix the IV pump problem, so she asks for an escalation draft.
tiered-huddle-board-escalation-draft.after: The draft gives the reason, the new clock and who would be paged. Nothing is sent until she confirms.

tiered-huddle-board-closure-check.before: Biomed says the bed alarm is fixed. Can it come off the board?
tiered-huddle-board-closure-check.after: Not yet. A mitigated issue stays open until the person who raised it confirms the fix held.

tiered-huddle-board-leadership-decisions.before: The chief nursing officer asks what the 10:30 leadership huddle must decide.
tiered-huddle-board-leadership-decisions.after: Two decisions, most urgent first, each with its reason, clock and owner.

tiered-huddle-board.status: reviewed - Emma voice picked by Kody

account-intelligence.intro: This is a preview of the Account Intelligence Agent, answering from sample records.
account-intelligence.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

account-intelligence-account-overview.before: An account executive wants an account overview and the signals worth acting on.
account-intelligence-account-overview.after: The overview shows a health score of 78 and flags a new technology chief as the window to engage.

account-intelligence-stakeholder-map.before: The account executive asks for a map of the buying committee.
account-intelligence-stakeholder-map.after: Eight stakeholders are mapped, with no introduction yet to the new technology chief. Nothing is sent or logged.

account-intelligence-competitive-intel.before: A sales director wants to know how the competition stacks up on this account.
account-intelligence-competitive-intel.after: The team leads on product fit and speed, while one competitor is pushing a fifteen percent discount.

account-intelligence-value-messaging.before: The account executive asks for talking points for each person in the meeting.
account-intelligence-value-messaging.after: Talking points are drafted per role, with objection handling. Nothing is sent until the executive reviews it.

account-intelligence.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

ai-customer-assistant.intro: This is a preview of the Customer Escalations Agent, answering from sample records.
ai-customer-assistant.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

ai-customer-assistant-handle-inquiry.before: A back-office agent inherits an export error escalation and wants the full brief.
ai-customer-assistant-handle-inquiry.after: The brief shows a frustrated enterprise customer, a known bug with long date ranges, and the matching article.

ai-customer-assistant-knowledge-search.before: The agent asks which approved guidance covers the failed long-range export.
ai-customer-assistant-knowledge-search.after: The known-issue article explains the cause and the workaround: split the export into 30 day segments.

ai-customer-assistant-escalation-routing.before: An escalation manager asks where the urgent sign-in migration case should go.
ai-customer-assistant-escalation-routing.after: The rulebook points to tier two engineering with a two hour target. Nothing is routed yet.

ai-customer-assistant-satisfaction-surve.before: A quality analyst wants the latest service snapshot and what needs human review.
ai-customer-assistant-satisfaction-surve.after: Satisfaction sits at 4.3 of 5, and one unresolved sign-in complaint is flagged for immediate follow-up.

ai-customer-assistant.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

ask-hr.intro: This is a preview of the Ask HR Agent, answering from sample records.
ask-hr.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

ask-hr-leave-balance.before: An employee asks about their leave balance and the notice rules.
ask-hr-leave-balance.after: They have 14 vacation days, and requests of five days or more need two weeks notice.

ask-hr-submit-time-off.before: The employee wants to preview a week of vacation in September.
ask-hr-submit-time-off.after: The preview counts three business days and stays a draft. Nothing is submitted until the employee confirms.

ask-hr-parental-leave.before: An employee asks for the published parental leave example, without sharing family details.
ask-hr-parental-leave.after: It lists eight to sixteen weeks of paid leave and a stipend, and notes eligibility needs HR review.

ask-hr-health-insurance.before: The employee wants a summary of their health plan and what must be verified.
ask-hr-health-insurance.after: The plan details are summarized, and dependent eligibility is left for the benefits administrator to confirm.

ask-hr.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

asset-maintenance-forecast.intro: This is a preview of the Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent, answering from sample records.
asset-maintenance-forecast.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

asset-maintenance-forecast-maintenance-f.before: A plant manager needs an immediate read on the wind farm turbines.
asset-maintenance-forecast-maintenance-f.after: One turbine is critical with 18 to 30 days to failure. Bundling three repairs saves about 19 thousand dollars.

asset-maintenance-forecast-asset-health.before: A reliability engineer asks for the weakest turbine and whether this authorizes operation.
asset-maintenance-forecast-asset-health.after: The weakest turbine is flagged critical, but this is advisory only. A qualified engineer must make the call.

asset-maintenance-forecast-budget-projec.before: A finance partner asks how much to reserve for the at-risk turbines.
asset-maintenance-forecast-budget-projec.after: The agent recommends reserving about 70 thousand dollars by bundling the three repairs into one window.

asset-maintenance-forecast-work-order-pl.before: A maintenance planner wants a bundled repair plan, without creating any work orders.
asset-maintenance-forecast-work-order-pl.after: The draft splits three repairs across two crews in the low-wind window. No work orders are created.

asset-maintenance-forecast.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

benefits-enrollment-assistant.intro: This is a preview of the Benefits Enrollment Agent, answering from sample records.
benefits-enrollment-assistant.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

benefits-enrollment-assistant-enrollment.before: An employee asks when open enrollment closes and what they can change.
benefits-enrollment-assistant-enrollment.after: Enrollment closes November 20, and they can switch plans, change dependents and set up spending accounts.

benefits-enrollment-assistant-life-event.before: A new parent asks what benefit changes they can make, and by when.
benefits-enrollment-assistant-life-event.after: They have 30 days from the birth to add the child, and the documents needed are listed.

benefits-enrollment-assistant-compare-pl.before: The employee wants the three medical plans compared for family coverage.
benefits-enrollment-assistant-compare-pl.after: The comparison shows premiums, deductibles and networks side by side, with the lowest premium plan called out.

benefits-enrollment-assistant-provider-n.before: The employee asks whether two local clinics are in network on each plan.
benefits-enrollment-assistant-provider-n.after: One clinic is covered on every plan. The pediatric clinic is out of network on the base plan.

benefits-enrollment-assistant.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

briefing-pack-builder.intro: This is a preview of the Briefing Pack Builder Agent, answering from sample records.
briefing-pack-builder.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

briefing-pack-builder-list-templates.before: A briefing coordinator asks what kinds of briefings the agent can build.
briefing-pack-builder-list-templates.after: It offers five formats, from a budget hearing brief to a short rapid response brief.

briefing-pack-builder-content-scan.before: A budget analyst asks what the city holds on the bridge replacement project.
briefing-pack-builder-content-scan.after: It finds eight relevant passages across six documents, including the capital budget and council transcript.

briefing-pack-builder-figure-check.before: Before drafting, the analyst asks whether any of the figures disagree.
briefing-pack-builder-figure-check.after: Two figures conflict, the budget and the amount spent. The agent will not pick one without confirmation.

briefing-pack-builder-draft-brief.before: The coordinator asks for a budget hearing brief on the bridge project.
briefing-pack-builder-draft-brief.after: The draft is ready, with the figure conflict flagged at the top for confirmation before it goes anywhere.

briefing-pack-builder.status: first pass - Emma voice, scored against the Cowork reference

build-materials-compliance-weekly-change.before: A procurement compliance lead asks what changed on approved bills of materials this week.

build-materials-compliance-compliance-ch.before: The lead asks whether anything has newly fallen out of compliance.

build-materials-compliance-compliant-alt.before: A buyer wants a compliant replacement for the gate valve with the same spec.
build-materials-compliance-compliant-alt.after: A same-spec valve with a valid certificate is recommended, at a modest added cost and a 14 day lead time.

build-materials-compliance-vendor-watch.before: A supplier quality manager asks which vendor certificates have lapsed or will soon.
build-materials-compliance-vendor-watch.after: One certificate has expired and two expire within weeks. Renewal requests are drafted only on approval.

building-permit-processing.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

permit-backlog.before: A development services director asks which permit applications have waited too long.
permit-backlog.after: Three permits are overdue, and the school district application carries the highest complaint risk.

permit-intake.before: A permit technician asks what should not be accepted at the counter today.
permit-intake.after: One application is a duplicate to reject, and another is held until the missing approval letter arrives.

permit-routing.before: The technician asks who must review a new restaurant fit-out, and when.

permit-updates.before: A customer service lead wants status updates to cut down on calls.

campaign-delivery-optimizer-campaign-ris.before: An ad operations manager asks whether a streaming campaign is falling behind this week.

care-gap-closure.intro: This is a preview of the Care Gap Closure Agent, answering from sample records.
care-gap-closure.outro: Like it? Get it into your own Copilot Studio with one line.

care-gap-closure-gap-analysis.before: A quality manager asks which measure has the largest evidence review queue.
care-gap-closure-gap-analysis.after: Colorectal screening leads with 182 records to review, and every one still needs reviewer validation.

care-gap-closure-cohort-review.before: A care coordinator wants the review cohorts organized, without clinical risk scoring.
care-gap-closure-cohort-review.after: Records are grouped by evidence completeness and routed to staff, portal or privacy review queues.

care-gap-closure-outreach-draft.before: The coordinator asks for screening outreach, without sending it or stating eligibility.
care-gap-closure-outreach-draft.after: A neutral draft invites patients to contact the care team. Nothing is sent until reviewers approve.
